description: A host resolving to a private, link-local or mapped-IPv4 address is refused in both address families; a host with one public and one private address is refused. Documentation ranges (192.0.2.0/24, 198.51.100.0/24, 203.0.113.0/24) are not globally reachable and are refused like every other IANA special-purpose block.
